# Does your company need a whistleblower channel, and does yours pass?

> Free EU Whistleblower Directive checker for employers: whether you must run an internal reporting channel at your headcount, which requirements are still open, and the 7-day and 3-month clocks for a report. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
